notes: The director's word is now final on subject LoRAs. Last build taught the director to pick one LoRA per concept and capped the stack's total strength — and the very next route line showed the remaining hole: the director dutifully picked only Footjob, but Feet and Showing Feet climbed aboard anyway through their overlapping WHEN keywords, because keyword matches were unioned with picks. Three half-strength near-duplicates is still worse than one clean full-strength LoRA. Now, when the director returns a picks list, keyword-matched subject LoRAs it did not pick stand down — logged by name — so the picked concept rides at its full card strength. Keywords remain the complete baseline whenever the director fails or stays silent, and identity cards and always-on style LoRAs are never stood down. The strength cap from last build stays as the backstop for whatever still stacks.
